answer: Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 7 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. Histories are stored in forge, checked in wharf, and terrace makes public each void. The per-identity price is 101 dollars, and it is forfeited outright on the first bad verdict. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
